videos.title: From Scratch 1: Mattress to bank run
Part 1: From a Pile of Shares to Zero Tax
videos.hook: If you buy shares and never sell, you've built a tax shelter. Add a loan and a funeral, and you've built buy, borrow, die: the chain that let America's 25 richest grow $401B richer at a 3.4% true tax rate (ProPublica, 2021).

videos.title: Part 2: From a Fortune to Tax-Free Heirs
videos.hook: Put your fortune in a box for your kids, lock it, and only lend it your shares: that's a GRAT. Congress created it by accident in 1990, and its pioneer estimates it has cost the Treasury more than $100B (Bloomberg, 2013).

videos.title: Part 3: From a House to Lawsuit-Proof
videos.hook: If you own nothing in your own name, a lawsuit can't take anything. Rudy Giuliani owed $148M and still kept his Florida condo (settlement, Jan 16, 2025).

videos.title: Part 4: From One Taxi to an Empty Company
videos.hook: If your business owns nothing, a lawsuit can't take anything. A 1966 New York taxi case showed how, and today's OpCo/PropCo splits and Johnson & Johnson's Texas two-step took it further.
